proposal.observation: Round 2 preserved all 10 rings and improved sam_fill_rate from 0.7404 to 0.7481, boundary_explained_edge@25 from 0.8359 to 0.8531, chamfer_sym_px from 84.29 to 81.29, and phase_incoherence_deg from 24.2 to 18.7. However, depth_nan_ratio increased from 0.1204 to 0.1271 and correspondence_f1@15 remained effectively flat at 0.3216. The after depth map still contains internal voids, especially in the sparse left portion, while the prompt set remains complete and regularly ordered.
proposal.rule: When an accepted incumbent has correct ring count and improved downstream alignment but a worse depth-hole ratio, preserve its enhancement, detection, and SAM settings and modestly widen the radial retention interval to recover lining support before projection.
proposal.rationale: The accepted incumbent already improved downstream structure, so changing Hough or SAM settings risks discarding that gain. Lowering mask_r_low from 2.2712 to 2.25 and raising mask_r_high from 2.8500 to 2.87 widens the retained radial band conservatively within bounds, targeting spatially missing lining support without touching locked unfolding. This is a targeted hypothesis based on the increased depth_nan_ratio and visible voids; no effect is attributed to either endpoint independently.
